title: The questions a useful tool still leaves to you
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Set the purpose — State the decision or outcome the work should support.; Delegate an operation — Identify exactly what the tool is expected to do.; Check the result — Inspect evidence, assumptions, and an awkward example.; Own the consequence — Keep responsibility and future maintenance explicit..
